data.name: Crownless
data.detailed_description:
Enter an expansive world filled with life and forge your own path as you slay through enemies and help others while gearing up and exploring different zones, dungeons, raids, quests and character builds. Choose your own playstyle and build your character to match it. Help other players become stronger.. or fight them in PvP. Write your own story.

Features:

  • Questing

  • Leveling

  • Grouped Leveling

  • Dungeons

  • Raids

  • PVP

  • Arenas

  • Gathering

  • Crafting

Genre

Crownless is a strictly Online Multiplayer game that encourages you to play with other players. Engaging with members of the community will greatly assist you in becoming stronger and more successful. 

Endgame

Level up to a max of level 40 to be able to compete in endgame challenges such as Raids and Arena PvP. The harder content you clear, the stronger you will become.

However other content is reachable as you battle your way towards level 40 such as, Dungeons, Gathering/Crafting, Questing, Leveling and Open World PvP

data.short_description: Forge your path in Crownless, an indie-fantasy MMORPG with many roads to explore. Discover dangerous worlds, experience meaningful progression, and engage with the community along your journey!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4570 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (2GB) / AMD RX 560 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 cores)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super/ RTX 2060 or AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Our game contains fantasy-themed violence. Players engage in frequent combat using weapons and magic against monsters, animals, undead, and humanoid enemies. Combat may include mild blood effects and death animations (e.g., enemies falling and disappearing after defeat), but there are no graphic depictions of gore.

The game also includes dark fantasy and horror elements, such as undead creatures, necromancy themes, haunted areas, and occasional disturbing environments typical of a fantasy war setting.

There are no depictions of sexual acts and no nudity beyond non-explicit fantasy character/armor designs. The game does not include depictions of sexual assault or non-consensual sex, and it does not include depictions or encouragement of self-harm.

The world may feature alcohol references (e.g., taverns, in-game beverages, comedic “drunken” effects) and fantasy substances/poisons used in quests or combat, but there are no realistic depictions of drug use.

Because this is an online multiplayer game, players may encounter user-generated content (chat, character names, guild names) that could include strong language or offensive behavior. We provide tools such as chat filters and reporting/muting features to help manage unwanted interactions.
